data.acceptance:
- A test that panics mid-body leaves no directory behind under the temp root.
- A full `cargo test --bin knots` run leaves no net new `/tmp/knots-*` trees
  once the process exits.
- `scripts/repo/reap-stale-artifacts.sh` reaps stale temp-root knots workspaces
  as well as `$ROOT/target`, honouring the same `MAX_AGE_HOURS` cutoff and the
  same stamp-file comparison.
- The reaper still refuses a zero or non-numeric `MAX_AGE_HOURS`, and still
  reports when it removed nothing.
- Workspace creation goes through one shared helper rather than 85 copies, or,
  if the migration is staged, the knot states plainly which files remain on the
  old pattern and why.
- No test asserts on a hard-coded `/tmp` path; `TMPDIR` is respected.
